# A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing

> A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing provides premium mobile interior car detailing, deep steam shampooing, and salt stain removal in Kitchener-Waterloo.

A-Shine Auto Mobile Detailing provides interior auto detailing, steam cleansing, stain extraction, odor sanitization, and commercial truck cab detailing in Kitchener and Waterloo, Ontario. Fully insured with 8+ years of experience.

## Services
- Full Interior Shampoo (Small Car): Complete interior deep clean & shampooing for sedans & coupes including seats, carpets, dashboard, vents, door jambs, and trunk.
- Full Interior Shampoo (5-Seater SUV): Deep interior shampooing & sanitization for 5-seater SUVs, crossovers & pickups including seats, carpets, dashboard, console, and cargo area.
- Full Interior Shampoo (7-Seater / Large): Full interior deep clean & shampooing for 7-seater SUVs, minivans & large trucks including all 3 rows, carpet salt extraction, and heavy spill cleanup.
- Pickup Truck Detailing: Full cab seat shampooing, floor mat & carpet extraction, dashboard, console, door panels, steam cleansing, and salt removal for standard and work trucks.
- Day Cab Truck Detailing: Mobile interior detailing for semi-trucks & commercial day cabs including cab seat shampooing, floor & pedal deep clean, dashboard, gauges, and steam sanitization.
- Sleeper Bed Truck Detailing: Complete detailing for sleeper cab semi-trucks & long-haul rigs including cab & sleeper berth shampooing, mattress deep clean & sanitization, gauges, storage compartments, and curtains.
- Steam Cleansing & Salt Removal: High-temperature steam cleansing that dissolves embedded winter salt, grime, bacteria, and stubborn floor mat stains.
- Seat Stain & Spill Extraction: Specialized hot-water extraction and conditioning for accidental food, drink, or pet spills on seats and carpets.
- Odor & Air Sanitization: Complete cabin deodorization and sanitization using ozone therapy and thermal steam to destroy bacteria, smoke, and mold odors.
- Commercial & Heavy Equipment Cabs: Professional mobile interior detailing for semi-trucks, dump trucks, loaders, and commercial vehicle cabs.
- Mobile Service or Studio Drop-off: Mobile service directly at client driveways or studio drop-off options.

## Service Area
Kitchener, Waterloo
